topic: A teacher receives an unexpected gift from a former student
text: Today, after class, I found a small, neatly wrapped box on my desk. It was from Marcus, a student who graduated a couple of years ago. As I opened it, a warm surge filled my chest. Inside was a beautifully crafted pen, along with a note. The note read, "Thank you for believing in me. Your encouragement meant the world." I fingered the pen, reflecting on the times we'd spent crafting essays and debating ideas. It's moments like these that make all the effort worthwhile. I can't wait to write my next lecture with this new, thoughtful addition to my desk.
